location.full_address: Vu Yen Island, Thuy Nguyen Ward, Hai Phong City, Vietnam

general_information.summary: Nestled on Vu Yen Island, just a 15-minute drive from the bustling city center, Vinpearl Golf Hai Phong delivers a unique golfing experience with 36 holes spread across two distinctive courses. The Marsh Course is renowned for its challenging natural marshy terrain, while the Lake Course boasts breathtaking landscapes intertwined with diverse water features, offering players a serene yet exciting golfing adventure.
general_information.course_length: Lake Course: 7,318 yards; Marsh Course: 7,508 yards
general_information.terrain_and_landscape: Natural marshy terrain (Marsh Course); Landscapes with diverse water features (Lake Course); Island golf course
